technique_name: Outline the unique elements of a rock garden.
description: A rock garden is an exceptional way to add beauty, character and charm to a landscaping project. It is composed of rocks of various shapes, sizes and textures. The rocks are laid out in a complementary pattern that is inspired by natural arrangements found in nature. The rocks can be strategically placed to create hills, valleys and pathways that provide a unique design element. Plants can be incorporated in between the rocks that can be tailored to the garden based on desired mood or aesthetic.
